sources.title: SwinIR: Image Restoration Using Swin Transformer - GitHub
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a strong baseline model SwinIR for image restoration based on the Swin Transformer. SwinIR consists of three parts: shallow feature extraction, deep feature extraction and high-quality image reconstruction.
